milestone: FIRST PACKET OF CHECKPOINT P, the first eight-packet parallel wave. Accepted with zero findings on the first round.
adjudications: 13.7.2.3.8 gives NO latitude for a processor to substitute an unsupported mode. The explicit UP, DOWN, ZERO, NEAREST and COMPATIBLE results are required by p3; only NEAREST ties and PROCESSOR_DEFINED are processor dependent, and neither is asserted.
UP on -1.25 at d=1 gives -1.2: p3 requires the smallest representable value greater than or equal to the original.

The COMPATIBLE tie uses exact binary -1.25, genuinely halfway between -1.2 and -1.3; away-from-zero gives -1.3. RN is only ever used on the NON-tie 1.125, so RN<->RC is never used as a substitution on a value where RN is processor dependent.

The duplicate required-mode tables are legitimate rather than double counting: 13.7.2.3.8 owns the mode semantics and 13.8.8 owns the descriptor-to-mode mapping, and each section states its own obligation.
The decimal/internal-direction fixture claims conversion-direction and definition facets of p2, not rounding behaviour; exact cases are acceptable for that claim.
ROUND= on the data-transfer statement writing to an internal file is conforming: R1213 permits ROUND=, C1229 only requires a format or namelist, and 12.6.2.14 defines its temporary effect.

discrimination.RN_vs_RC: only on a tie where RN is processor dependent, left pending

non_vacuity.all_detected: 61/61 on gfortran; 56/56 on the LFortran-passing cases

lfortran_defects_recorded.observation: WRITE(buf,'(SS,F5.1)',ROUND='DOWN') 1.25 gives '  1.3' on frozen LFortran; gfortran gives the required '  1.2'. The ROUND= specifier on the data-transfer statement is ignored while the same mode through OPEN and through the RD descriptor is honoured.
lfortran_defects_recorded.basis: 13.7.2.3.8 p3 (DOWN), R1213 and 12.6.2.14 (temporary change of mode by the data-transfer specifier)

limitations: Reference validation is gfortran 16.1.0 in f2023 mode on one platform.
Input rounding is exercised only on an exact value.
